keyboard.action: Moves between links and the expander button (native tab order).
Follows the link; emits cancelable aui-navigate first.
Reveals the full trail in place and moves focus to the first revealed item.

focus: No focus management except after expanding: focus moves to the first revealed item (made programmatically focusable when it is text), so focus never falls back to the document body.
notes: The ordered list conveys the number of levels and each item's position.
Separators are decorative icons, not text characters, so they are not announced.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
